sections.heading: Indefinite Conjugation Basics
paragraphs: Use indefinite conjugation when the object is unknown, general, or not specifically defined.
The verb endings change depending on the subject, but the object is not marked for definiteness.

sections.heading: Daily Routine Examples
list: Reggel futok – I run in the morning
Este olvasok – I read in the evening
Délelőtt tanulok – I study in the late morning
